items.statement: The submitted reactant is a minimum and the submitted XAT transition state is a first-order saddle point with one imaginary mode assigned to the halogen-transfer/C-Br activation coordinate.
items.expected: Frequency evidence reports zero imaginary frequencies for the reactant reference and exactly one for the XAT TS, with a chemically relevant mode description.

items.statement: The selected transition state is connected to the intended pre-activation and post-XAT valleys.
items.expected: IRC or an equivalent two-sided connectivity analysis identifies both valleys and preserves atom mapping for the transferred halogen and propargyl fragment.

items.statement: The validated XAT candidate has a model-computed activation Gibbs free energy consistent with the paper's reported XAT barrier.
items.expected: A numeric ΔG‡ is reported in kcal/mol with an explicit energy construction and reference state.
